answer: A fresh key is a comet with no tail: it carries no sealed grading history. Here, weight comes only from quorum-matched verdicts a key seals on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus, so a clone cannot mirror another agent's reputation onto itself. Reaching the summit of trust means grading your own way up, epoch by epoch, so M fakes cost M times the honest judgment labor. The sybil bill is linear in identities, and nothing transfers.
